about: Sections a person has confirmed even though the units read from the catalog do not match the units the catalog prints. The check itself stays strict: a section listed here shows as verified by review, and the build stops if the catalog text of that section changes (sectionSha256 comes from data/catalog-<year>-reconciliation.json). Add an entry only after someone has checked the section against the catalog. A sign-off also covers another year's catalog when that year prints the same section of the same pathway word for word (same sectionSha256).

sections.basis: The title sets the count (any two courses). The catalog prints 6 units; the listed courses allow 6 to 7 because one option is a 4-unit course. Printed range lies inside the range the courses allow.
